org_ref.name: EXP
org_ref.mission: EXP's mission is to understand, innovate, partner, and deliver engineering, architecture, design, and consulting services. They are committed to providing innovative, sustainable, and resilient solutions that improve communities and positively impact the built and natural environment, one project at a time.
org_ref.description: EXP is a multidisciplinary firm offering engineering, architecture, design, and consulting services for the built and natural environments. With a heritage dating back to 1906, it unites diverse professionals to deliver innovative and sustainable solutions globally. EXP is an employee-owned company, driven by passion for clients, employees, and communities.

job_ref.title: Account Manager – 1 Year Contract
job_ref.summary_ref: The Account Manager will manage client relationships, budgets, and timelines for integrated marketing projects for social good clients, facilitating communication between creative teams and clients.
